subject: Clarifying PII/PHI retention limits and redaction options for regulated workloads
messages:

Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

Subject: Questions on PII/PHI retention & redaction for regulated workloads

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — appreciate the walkthrough. Before we proceed to procurement I need a clear answer on a few compliance items so I can sign off with InfoSec: 

- Residency: Can customer content and audit logs be guaranteed to remain in the US region only? Any exceptions?
- Retention limits: What are the default and maximum retention periods for raw text containing PHI? Can we set a policy of "retain 0 days" for generation payloads?
- Deletion & proof: If we request deletion, what is the timeline across primary store, caches, and backups? Do you provide a certificate or attestation of deletion?
- Redaction options: Is there built-in PII/PHI masking at ingest (before model processing)? Can you support deterministic pseudonymization / tokenization so we never store raw PHI?
- For audit: How long are API request/response logs retained and can they be scoped or exported for third-party audits?

I attached a small data inventory to illustrate the types of fields we ingest (midcorp_data_inventory.csv). Please loop in compliance/engineering.

Would like a written summary we can include with our DPA.

Thanks,
Karen Liu
Director, Information Security
MidCorp Health

Subject: Re: Questions on PII/PHI retention & redaction for regulated workloads

Hi Karen and team — thanks for the inventory. Below is a concise, written summary you can include with the DPA. I kept timelines conservative; we can tighten some of these under Dedicated/Private contracts.

1) Data residency
- Hosted (standard): We support strict region pinning by account. For MidCorp Health we can lock processing and primary storage to the US-EAST region; cross-region replication is disabled by default for pinned accounts.
- Dedicated/Private: Customers can run in VPC or on-prem where no data leaves the customer network.

2) Retention defaults and limits
- Default behavior (hosted): Request/response payloads and derived artifacts are retained for 30 days by default. Audit logs and usage aggregates are retained for 90 days.
- Configurable policies: We expose per-account retention settings (console + API). Retention can be shortened to a minimum of 0 days for primary store metadata and payloads for accounts on Dedicated/Private plans or by contract amendment.
- Maximum: We do not impose a hard maximum; customers can elect longer retention for analytics but must specify in contract.

3) Deletion & proof-of-deletion
- Deletion process: Deletion requests (UI/API) mark records for immediate removal from the primary index within 24 hours. Caches and ephemeral KV stores are cleared within 24 hours.
- Backups & cold storage: Rolling backups are purged on a 30-day cycle by default. For regulated workloads we can reduce backup retention to 0–7 days, or include a contractual clause guaranteeing same-day purge for backups in Private deployments.
- Attestation: We provide a signed deletion attestation (PDF) within 5 business days on request; for Dedicated/Private customers this can be automated into your audit package.

4) Redaction & pseudonymization options
- Ingest-time redaction: We offer a built-in PII detector that can redact or mask fields before model execution. This is configurable as: mask (replace with token), remove (strip the field), or pseudonymize (deterministic tokenization).
- Deterministic tokenization: Returns consistent pseudonyms for the same input using customer-scoped salts (KMS-backed) so you can re-identify only with the customer key. This avoids storing raw PHI in persistent stores.
- Post-processing redaction: For outputs containing PHI, we offer a post-processing filter pipeline to redact detected PHI before persistence.
- Config enforcement: Policies can be enforced account-wide and audited via our Console and Audit API.

5) Logs & audit exports
- API request/response logs: Default retention 90 days. We can scope logging to exclude response bodies for highly sensitive accounts.
- Audit exports: We support on-demand export (CSV/JSON) and S3 delivery. Drilldown logs and tamper-evident audit trails are available under Enterprise plans.

Attached: PII_Retention_Table.xlsx — a matrix that maps data types to suggested retention and redaction defaults.

If MidCorp would like 0-day persistent retention for generation payloads and a contract clause to the same effect, we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment so we can guarantee backup behaviour and contractual SLAs. Happy to walk through the matrix on a quick call.

Regards,
Ava Chen
Senior Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com

Hi all — adding the engineering details for the deletion/purge APIs and operational timelines so your SREs can review: 

- Delete API: DELETE https://api.redwood.com/v1/accounts/{account_id}/data?scope=payload|conversation|all
  - Returns 202 Accepted with tracing id. Primary store deletions propagate within 24 hours.
- Purge job for backups: POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/accounts/{account_id}/purge-backups
  - Default behavior: asynchronous job; completion estimated within 48–72 hours once scheduled. Backups are on a rolling 30-day cycle by default.
- Cache eviction: In-memory KV caches and model prefix caches are flushed within 1 hour of deletion request; we also provide a hard flush endpoint for emergency ops.
- Audit log handling: We can configure log retention and redact response bodies at ingestion. Audit logs are WORM-protected for the configured retention period.

Operational notes:
- For hosted accounts we cannot guarantee instantaneous removal from offsite backups unless enumerated in contract.
- For Dedicated/Private customers we support: backup disablement, same-day backup purge, and customer-managed KMS so raw PHI never leaves encrypted form.

Verification & attestation: We can provide a deletion token and signed attestation (attestation available via Console or API). For emergency compliance actions we offer a SOC/Compliance runbook and a support SLA to escalate deletes.

Attachments: DPA_redline_v2.pdf (suggested legal clause language that maps our retention options to contractual language).

--
